fields.name: compressive_strength_class
fields.rationale: The compressive strength class (e.g., C30/37) is a key property of concrete that indicates its load-bearing capacity, which is crucial for structural applications.

fields.name: maximum_aggregate_size
fields.rationale: The maximum aggregate size affects the workability and strength of the concrete mix, influencing its suitability for different construction applications.

fields.name: exposure_classes
fields.rationale: Exposure classes (e.g., XC4, XF1, XA1, XD1) define the environmental conditions the concrete is designed to withstand, such as corrosion or freeze-thaw cycles.
